WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    mlp.product_name,
    mlp.brand,
    mlp.model,
    mlp.price_eur,
    mlp.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.last_seen = l.max_date
ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    mlp.product_name,
    mlp.brand,
    mlp.price_eur,
    mlp.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN max_date md
WHERE mlp.category = 'laptop'
  AND mlp.last_price_date = md.dt
  AND mlp.last_seen = md.dt
ORDER BY mlp.price_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS prices_collected
FROM price_snapshots
WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    category,
    drop_date,
    prev_price,
    new_price,
    drop_eur,
    drop_pct,
    skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY drop_eur ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    v.product_name,
    v.brand,
    v.model,
    v.drop_pct,
    v.drop_eur,
    v.drop_date,
    v.skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops v
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE v.category = 'laptop'
  AND v.drop_date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY v.drop_pct ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS dropped_products
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_products_count
FROM products, max_dt
WHERE first_seen >= max_dt.max_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(mlp.price_eur)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest_dt ld
WHERE mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.last_seen = ld.dt
  AND mlp.price_eur IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50

SELECT brand, product_count
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'phone'
ORDER BY product_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT category, brand, median_price AS median_price_eur
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'tablet' AND brand = 'Apple'
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    mlp.product_name,
    mlp.brand,
    mlp.model,
    mlp.price_eur,
    mlp.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE mlp.last_seen = ld.dt
  AND mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.product_name ILIKE '%iPhone 15%'
ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH cheapest_s24 AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.brand, mlp.price_eur AS latest_price
    FROM products p
    JOIN mv_latest_prices mlp ON mlp.id = p.id
    WHERE p.category = 'phone'
      AND p.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%'
      AND mlp.price_eur IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.product_name, c.brand, mpf.all_time_low AS lowest_price_ever_eur
FROM cheapest_s24 c
JOIN mv_price_floor mpf ON mpf.product_id = c.id
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT max(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
),
cheapest AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.brand
    FROM products p
    JOIN mv_latest_prices mlp ON mlp.id = p.id
    WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%'
      AND p.brand ILIKE 'Samsung'
      AND mlp.price_eur IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.product_name,
       c.brand,
       ps.date,
       ps.price_eur,
       ps.rating,
       ps.reviews
FROM cheapest c
JOIN price_snapshots ps ON ps.product_id = c.id
CROSS JOIN max_dt m
WHERE ps.date >= m.dt - interval '6 days'
ORDER BY ps.date
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS smartwatch_count
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE mlp.category = 'smartwatch'
  AND mlp.price_eur < 50
  AND mlp.last_seen = ld.dt
LIMIT 50

SELECT product_name, brand, rating, reviews, price_eur, skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop' AND reviews > 50
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS falling_trend_count
FROM mv_price_trend_direction
WHERE trend = 'falling'
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT max(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
tbl AS (
    SELECT date, avg_price
    FROM mv_daily_market_index, max_dt
    WHERE category = 'tablet'
      AND date >= max_dt.max_date - interval '1 month'
      AND date <= max_dt.max_date
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(date) AS first_date,
        MAX(date) AS last_date
    FROM tbl
)
SELECT
    b.first_date,
    (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.first_date) AS first_avg_price,
    b.last_date,
    (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.last_date) AS last_avg_price,
    (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.last_date) -
    (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.first_date) AS change_eur,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.first_date) <> 0
        THEN round(
            ((SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.last_date) -
             (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.first_date))
            / (SELECT avg_price FROM tbl WHERE date = b.first_date) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS change_pct
FROM bounds b
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS phones_with_16gb_ram_today
FROM products
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND ram_gb = 16
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50
